model_card.summary: One-way and two-way trained contrastive image/text matching checkpoints.
model_card.scope: Compare retrieval among six known colour/shape descriptions on held-out image positions.
limitations: Small generated tasks and fixed splits do not establish natural-image perception, speech recognition, general instruction following or broad multimodal reasoning.
Generated-input CPU component probes establish load/forward compatibility only; held-out retrieval scores are separate evidence.
Each test direction has six queries against the same six known descriptions; these scores do not establish open-vocabulary retrieval.
The text side is a mean embedding encoder, not an autoregressive caption model. Repeated images of the same description are not treated as distinct negatives.

training.loss_probe: same deterministic batch before and after training
training.timing_scope: optimizer loop including logging, periodic local checkpoints and CUDA synchronization; excludes probes, evaluation and final file write

inference.method: Run the component_probe_command for each downloaded custom checkpoint; explicit eval()+no_grad() CPU loading is described in inference_variants.
inference.scope: Generated-input component load/forward checks only; not task-quality or calibration evaluation.

one_way.pt.method: Construct scripts.course_experiments.modalities._Contrastive() on CPU; load saved["model"] strictly; call model.eval(); under torch.no_grad(), compute scores(images, six known descriptions).
one_way.pt.scope: CPU load/forward component smoke check on generated input only; not a task-quality or calibration evaluation.

review.scope: Reviewed two custom Contrastive final checkpoints, exact file hashes, fixed architecture/temperature/tokenizer/pooling and fresh initialization. Six held-out queries in each direction and no observed two-way advantage are scoped to known descriptions; component probes establish loading only. Public export requires native reconstruction and anonymous pinned-file verification before actual student CPU probes.
